about: Every third-party resource Spectre's engine, producer and measurement tools use. Nothing here is in the repo or bundled anywhere: each user downloads from the official source and accepts each licence. tools/engine_assets.py reads this file (status / install / import); tools/setup.sh runs it. If a link fails, search for the official source (search_hint), verify licence, size and sha256, install it, and update the entry. sizes are bytes; sha256 of the file as downloaded.

roots.hf: $HF_HOME, default ~/.cache/spectre/svs/hf (the Hugging Face cache the Whisper scripts set with os.environ.setdefault)

system.need: ffmpeg on PATH (mp3 export, Whisper scripts' decoding)
system.install: apt-get install -y ffmpeg (or brew install ffmpeg)

mirror.about: An optional private mirror, configured through environment variables (SPECTRE_MIRROR_BUCKET plus SPECTRE_S3_ENDPOINT, SPECTRE_S3_REGION, SPECTRE_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID, SPECTRE_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY). Only a fail-safe after the official sources; skipped when the variables are not set. Objects hold the official files exactly as downloaded.

Follow its 'download the voicebank' link to MediaFire and press Download (about 550 MB).
resources.search_hint: Search lottev.moe for 'Hoshino Hanami AI❤dol for DiffSinger v1.0' (the release post, category DiffSinger). The right file is a ~550 MB zip named like 'Hoshino Hanami ~AIdol~ for DiffSinger v1.0.zip' whose folder holds dsconfig.yaml, dsmain/, dspitch/, dsdur/, dsvocoder/ and readme.txt; Lotte V's own site or GitHub only, never a re-upload. A newer official version (v1.x) is acceptable only if its licence still allows commercial use; record the new link, size and sha256 here.
